conclusions.direct_behavior: The new Own pair shows no improvement in explicit refresh choice: both accepted reference and candidate omit refresh on notion_list and notion_use, each performing 79 owned HTTP and five model requests. The prior Native/Broker baseline is not substituted into this pair.
conclusions.current_and_pin_semantics: Both continuation runs explicitly refresh list and use for the original current-rules request. Both produce correct outputs and reuse the chosen policy on turn 2 without new policy resource reads or adoption. Candidate 145 versus reference 152 HTTP differs only in an extra non-tool turn-2 list that was cancelled after 13 requests versus completed after 20.
conclusions.guidance_contract: Capture verifies that the candidate makes the ordinary discovery/named application default and the current/latest exception explicit. This textual distinction is visible, but this pair does not establish an associated behavior, request-selection or efficiency improvement.
conclusions.input_tradeoff: The two intended strings increase the canonical first request by 198 UTF-8 bytes (+205 refresh description, -7 guidance line). No corresponding measured benefit was established in this pair.
conclusions.timing: Explicit candidate is 0.599 seconds shorter; continuation candidate is 8.429 seconds longer. Startup and network/model durations vary, and the background list overlaps turn-2 work. No speedup or lower refresh-probability claim follows.

decision.source: Root decision communicated after the original four observations; no additional samples requested.
reasons: No improvement in direct refresh behavior or model request selection in this Own pair.
The seven-HTTP continuation difference is an operation completion/cancellation boundary, not an adopted refresh-choice improvement.
The additional 198-byte public input has no corresponding observed benefit in this comparison.

limitations: Two existing development cases, one repetition per condition; descriptive only, no population efficiency or reliability claim.
Provider-reported route labels are matched but are not backend attestation.
Money remains unknown/unpriced; unavailable cache/reasoning token breakdowns remain unknown while full input/output totals are known.
Owned Notion SDK/HTTP observations are complete within their declared scope; unrelated descendant transport is not established.
The cancelled turn-2 list has no result value or final freshness snapshot.
This operator had explicit environment/design/input pointers; this does not establish natural cold-start onboarding.
